purpose: Test deterministic completion of residual-cycle clearing, not enumeration of every simple cycle. Retain incomplete runs and report exact cost.
initial_balances: Uniform integer -6 through 6 on a ring plus uniformly sampled distinct undirected pairs.

arrivals.interpretation: First 1000 events of a Poisson process; stop by count, not fixed time. Uniform original trustline. Initial clearing and one fully drained service after each 100 accepted offers. Arrivals buffer during clearing; no real-time throughput claim.

control: Existing decrease-first headroom policy, 1024 application messages per original trustline total per run, evenly allocated across service epochs with unused credit carried. This is a finite-budget comparator; exact mode runs toward a certificate under a larger safety ceiling. Report actual costs rather than claim a matched-budget win.
primary_checks: Static broad exact completion must equal independently certified hard-bound L1 oracle.
Every certified broad arrival epoch must equal its own offline oracle, not only the final snapshot.
All transfers and settlements independently replayed; bilateral consent, hard grants, net positions, message accounting and drained state checked.
Narrow no-admissible-negative-cycle completion is not automatically a global hard-limit optimum.
Safety-ceiling exhaustion is incomplete, never a completeness certificate.
scoring: Each epoch compared with replay of exactly the same accepted prefix on the original ledger without clearing. Clearing potential = reference gross minus hard-bound minimum gross. Preserve negative savings and undefined zero-potential ratios.
versions: Freeze actor, runner, generator, auditor, plan, workloads and imported comfort code before performance runs. Python3.12.14 NetworkX3.5.
timing: One illustrative wall-clock sample per run; exclude oracle and independent audit work. Run all measurements serially without competing benchmarks.
limits: Static snapshots and integer units; reliable delivery; simulator-provided rounds/serialization must be disclosed separately from counted neighbour messages. Path-bearing tokens are not neighbour-private. No app/demo changes.
